scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Classify missing event identity before deduplication
cases.input_contract: Add reason missing_event_id for NULL event_id and accepted otherwise, retaining delivery_id, amount and event_time.
cases.expected: Delivery 3 is quarantined;known IDs are eligible for the separate deduplication policy.
cases.verification: Construct the first streaming classification with all declared fields and verify the exact quarantine row after the first phase.

cases.title: Define a bounded event-ID stateful operator
cases.input_contract: Filter accepted identities, drop the reason field, attach a five-minute watermark to event_time, and deduplicate within that watermark on event_id only.
cases.expected: The result remains streaming and retains delivery_id, event_id, amount, event_time. Equal amounts across distinct IDs remain distinct.
cases.verification: Assert output shape and use the explicit event_id key, then validate all retained identities through later sink checks.

cases.title: Execute accepted and quarantine branches with separate checkpoints
cases.input_contract: Run both first-phase branches with AvailableNow:deduplicated records to accepted-output and missing-ID records to quarantine-output. Use distinct checkpoints and bounded await/stop scopes.
cases.expected: Accepted(e1, delivery 1,10),(e2, delivery 2,10);quarantine(delivery 3, NULL, missing_event_id). The raw source has 3 rows;prepared branch input metrics report 2 accepted-eligible rows and 1 quarantine row.
cases.verification: Assert both exact output populations, branch metrics 2/1 and an independent raw batch-source count 3.

cases.title: Suppress a replay while retaining distinct equal-valued events
cases.input_contract: Publish the second file after the first phase terminates and run both compatible branches again. Compare the accepted business identities and their total.
cases.expected: Accepted(e1, delivery 1,10),(e2, delivery 2,10),(e3, delivery 5,10);delivery 4 replay contributes no additional row. Business total 30.
cases.verification: Assert all retained event/delivery pairs, sum 30, raw source total 5 and prepared branch metrics 2 accepted-eligible inputs versus 0 quarantined inputs for this phase.

cases.title: Observe state removal and state the retention limit
cases.input_contract: Publish the 00:20 advancer and run both branches. Sum actual numRowsRemoved state metrics from the accepted branch and inspect remaining state.
cases.expected: The three old business-key states are removed under the observed watermark progression;accepted output still retains their committed rows plus the advancer.
cases.verification: Assert removed state rows at least 3, unchanged business rows and one advancer output. Print actual state metrics without promising perpetual deduplication.

cases.title: Reconcile deliveries, quarantine, replay suppression and business totals
cases.input_contract: Read the six source deliveries once as a bounded batch and compare them with both sinks. Return source deliveries, known-ID deliveries, quarantine rows, accepted rows including advancer, and business total.
cases.expected: Ledger(6,5,1,4,30). One known-ID delivery is suppressed as an in-horizon replay;three distinct equal-valued business events remain.
cases.verification: Assert the complete ledger and six unique delivery IDs;confirm no active queries remain before cleanup.

golden.branch_metric_scope: PreparedSpark4.0.1 reports scan rows after branch filters;raw deliveries are independently counted.
